rationale: EditorBridge's view attachments (editor_bridge_attach.hpp, editor_bridge_scaffold.hpp) and the native runtime attachment (editor_bridge_native_runtime.cpp) are Pulp-kept: vellum_mirror_edge_patterns.json lists all three under mirror-pulp-kept-file, beside the view-free EditorBridge core in core/editor_bridge. Vellum serves its own view layer and does not take Pulp's editor-bridge attachments, so the next re-export does not carry them.
